slides.name: cover
slides.headline: Как нейросети ведут блог за 20 минут в день
slides.prompt: Instagram carousel slide 1/6 (COVER), 1080x1350 px, vertical 4:5. Premium editorial dark theme, pure jet black background with warm bronze-orange accents (#F5A623). Huge bold Russian Cyrillic typography: "Как нейросети ведут блог за 20 минут в день". Include an interactive rounded button pill badge saying "ЛИСТАЙ →". Include the real author face (confident professional author) seamlessly integrated on the right. At bottom right corner small neat text "Моя Студия · @my_studio". Clean, high resolution, no clutter.

slides.name: problem
slides.headline: В чем главная ошибка?
slides.prompt: Instagram carousel slide 2/6, 1080x1350 px, vertical 4:5. Premium minimalist dark background. Huge punchy Russian text: "90% ДЕЛАЮТ НЕ ТАК". A clean graphical comparison card or infographic element showing standard mistake vs effective method. Editorial layout, crisp Russian Cyrillic lettering, signature bottom footer: "Моя Студия · @my_studio".

slides.name: insight1

Bullet card explaining the core process. High contrast, elegant typography, perfectly readable Cyrillic, footer "Моя Студия · @my_studio".

slides.name: insight2
